text.p: --Hambrecht and Quist analyst Rachel Leheny said she initiated coverage of Aviron, a vaccine reseach company, with a "strong buy" rating.

--Leheny said the company is positioned to take advantage of the managed health care's emphasis on disease prevention with vaccines that "offer an ideal cost benefit for the ever tightening healthcare budget."

--The company's lead product candidate is a nasally administered flu vaccine which is in pivotal trials in children. Other projects include potential vaccines for Epstein-Barr virus, herpes simplex type 2, and a flu vaccine for the elderly.
